verdict.rationale: Pulumi Policies is a first-party policy-as-code feature: teams define guardrails in code and apply them across Pulumi, Terraform, CloudFormation and manually created resources. Policy violations surface in pull request comments and checks, which supports gating changes before they are applied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that policies block a preview or update (e.g. mandatory enforcement levels that fail a deployment), detail on how policy checks run during `pulumi preview`, and independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
